FLOW

A chain of useful decisions.

Unlock: 1,500 trophies · Flow.

What it does

FLOW scores varied techniques used at moments when they help, alongside lap time and DRIFT scoring.

How to do it

Link DRIFT, LOCK, EXIT, BOOST, CATCH, decisive BRAKE before a curve and useful SHIFT outcomes. For a first chain: bank a slide, exit cleanly, then BOOST.

Why use it

It rewards putting the whole driving toolkit together.

Timing

Use a different technique within five seconds of the last to raise COMBO, up to ×8. Repeating one adds little; a lost slide breaks the chain.

Advanced

EXIT follows at least 0.7 seconds of drift. BOOST must gain speed. SHIFT earns its place when the new setup helps the following action. Supercar’s FLOW SHIFT starts at ×3.

Practise it

Try CLIFFSIDE. Tutorials give you a guided starting point.
